title: ptarmica tenuifolia
intro: Ptarmica tenuifolia, commonly known as Tanacetum tenuifolium or tansy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. The health benefits of ptarmica tenuifolia include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and insect repellent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its traditional use as a wound treatment and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of ptarmica tenuifolia include thujone, camphor, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
